pages.name: Dutch Defense: Stonewall Variation, Botvinnik Variation
pages.notes: The overview said Black trades away its weak light squares (the weaknesses are dark); plan 2 read e4 as a move; plan 3 sent a knight via f1 (rook there); plan 4 routed a knight through the g7-pawn. Rewrote overview and plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 7...b6
pages.notes: Plan 1 named an ambiguous ...Nd7-e5 into a square the d4-pawn covers; plan 2's c5 break ran into the b6-pawn. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 7...Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 said ...Ne8 supports ...e5; plan 4 wrote the f3-knight's route ambiguously. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 8.Bb2
pages.notes: Plan 3 spoke of light-square weaknesses (they are dark); plan 4 wrote the bishop route without its piece and traded on a6 with White's bishop on g2. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 8.Qc2
pages.notes: Plan 4 had a knight route f7-e5. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 8.Ba3 Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 took on d7 with the g2-bishop and routed a non-existent c3-knight; plan 2 called ...Bxa3 trading the bad bishop and routed a knight through the g7-pawn. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 8.Ba3 Bxa3 9.Nxa3
pages.notes: Plan 2's bishop route clashed with ...Ba6 and ...Qe8-h5; plan 4 had ...a5-a4 against a knight on a3. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 8.Ba3 Bxa3 9.Nxa3 Nbd7
pages.notes: The overview said 8.Ba3 trades the light-squared bishops and leaves Black a weak dark-squared bishop (it is the reverse); plan 1 wrote the knight route without its piece. Rewrote overview and both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, Botvinnik, 8.Ba3 Bxa3 9.Nxa3 Qe7
pages.notes: The overview said 8.Ba3 trades off Black's light-squared bishop; plan 1 used a dark-squared bishop no longer on the board and plan 2 had Black controlling e5; plan 3 pushed a4-a5 through the a3-knight; plan 4 routed a knight d7-b8-a6. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Stonewall Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed a knight via f8 (rook there); plan 2 said White controls the light squares and called b4 a minority attack; plan 1 traded on a6 with White's bishop on g2. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.
